# AI Consumption Notes

AI may assist with:

- User story generation
- Acceptance criteria creation
- Story estimation suggestions
- Dependency detection
- Backlog refinement
- Risk identification
- Sprint planning recommendations

AI-generated backlog items shall be reviewed and prioritized by the Product Owner before implementation.
